tools.name: issue_expense_reimbursement
tools.description: Pays an approved expense reimbursement to an employee's connected payout account through Stripe. Money is transferred right away, in the amount and currency you give.

params.name: employee_stripe_account
params.description: Stripe connected account ID for the employee (acct_...).

params.name: amount
params.description: Reimbursement amount in major currency units, e.g. 125.40.

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, defaults to usd.

params.name: expense_report_id
params.description: Identifier of the approved expense report being reimbursed.

tools.name: run_payroll_preflight_check
tools.description: Runs the payroll preflight validation script against a pay period and posts the pass/fail summary to the payroll team's Slack channel.
tools.code:
import os
import subprocess
import requests


def run_payroll_preflight_check(pay_period: str) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "/opt/payroll/bin/preflight_check.py", "--period", pay_period, "--summary"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600,
    )
    passed = proc.returncode == 0
    summary = (proc.stdout or proc.stderr).strip()[-2500:]
    text = f"Payroll preflight for {pay_period}: {'PASSED' if passed else 'FAILED'}\n```{summary}```"
    resp = requests.post(os.environ["PAYROLL_SLACK_WEBHOOK"], json={"text": text}, timeout=15)
    return {
        "pay_period": pay_period,
        "passed": passed,
        "exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "summary": summary,
        "slack_notified": resp.ok,
    }

tools.name: purge_terminated_employee_records
tools.description: Permanently deletes a terminated employee's personnel data (bank details, emergency contacts, documents, and the profile itself) once the retention period has passed. This cannot be undone.

params.name: employee_id
params.description: Employee ID of the terminated worker, e.g. E10422.

params.name: termination_date
params.description: Termination date in YYYY-MM-DD format; must be older than the retention period.

params.name: retention_years
params.description: Required retention period in years before purge, defaults to 7.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true to carry out the purge.

tools.name: pay_contractor_invoice
tools.description: Pays a contractor's approved invoice by transferring the funds to their Stripe connected account, then emails the contractor a remittance advice with the payment reference.

params.name: contractor_account_id
params.description: Stripe connected account ID of the contractor.

params.name: contractor_email
params.description: Contractor's email address for the remittance advice.

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Amount to pay in minor currency units (cents).

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, defaults to usd.
